thread:
Lena V: Procurement from Meridian asked for a plain SLO summary + credit math they can include in the contract. Need a 1-page playbook.
Omar G: We should keep the measurable signals simple: uptime % (monthly) and p95 latency for generation routes.
Keisha L: Agreed. Proposed targets: 99.95% uptime; p95 < 150ms for generation endpoints after warmup.
Lena V: They also want an easy credit example they can show finance. Keep caps and exclusions clear.
LegalBot: Reminder: cap credits to 50% of monthly committed spend; permitted exclusions include scheduled maintenance and customer misconfigurations.
Omar G: Formula suggestion: credit = min(monthly_commitment * 0.75 * downtime_ratio, monthly_commitment * 0.5). Include worked examples.
Keisha L: Add claim process: submit within 14 days, attach evidence bundle (Console p95 screenshot, incident ID, trace samples). SRE validates within 10 business days.
Lena V: Also tie onboarding milestones to acceptance: API key, model pin + canary, warmup verification (10k tokens at p95 < 200ms).
Omar G: Note regional ramp: if customer requires global 150ms p95, offer phased SLA across regions with fallback routing and performance improvement plan.
Keisha L: I'll draft the 1-page and 2 worked examples (small and enterprise) and ping here for legal sign-off.
Lena V: Thanks. Target to send to Meridian by EOD.
